nodes.title: Define the v0.1 adoption, installation, and mutation contract
Run an external adoption pilot and fresh conformance suite

body:
## Objective

Demonstrate that Backplane can govern its own v0.1.0 product arc using the same native issue contract required of adopters.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Native lifecycle labels, parent/sub-issue relationships, blocking edges, revision reconciliation, artifact links, and closure evidence in this repository.
- Exercising at least one executable leaf through the complete lifecycle.

### Out of Scope

- GitHub Projects or IssueOps.
- Automated enforcement not required by field evidence.
- Treating local plans or handoff documents as the backlog master.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every open tracked issue has exactly one valid `backplane:*` label.
- The release hierarchy and dependencies are represented natively rather than duplicated as authoritative prose.
- At least one executable leaf progresses from backlog through verified completion under the approved contract.
- Issue, specification, plan, integration, and verification evidence remain correctly layered.

## Verification Seams

- Run complete native intake on every release issue and inspect label cardinality, hierarchy, blockers, linked closing pull requests, and `updatedAt`.
- Verify the selected leaf plan records its issue URL and consumed revision.
- Verify closure happens only after integrated acceptance and fresh project-owned verification.
- Exercise status, recommendation, and selection as zero-mutation paths, then authorized design, readiness, active, blocked, review, and completion transitions on disposable or explicitly authorized test issues; verify `updatedAt`, label cardinality, preserved unrelated labels, and blocker/PR gates after each action.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Design authority: the bounded issue body and the approved v0.1 adoption contract: https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md (approved 2026-09-19; #2 completed).

Approved implementation plan (operator approval 2026-11-01; unchanged blob 82ec8e3feee1d443859501dbbb98096a927700b7; consumed semantic revision 2026-09-19T14:16:55Z): https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-11-01-issue-5-self-hosting-validation.md

Published partial implementation and execution evidence, directly integrated into main by operator selection: 567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3.

Execution assessment (acceptance remains incomplete; no completed closure claimed): https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3/tests/scenarios/2026-11-01-issue-5-self-hosting.md

The operator approved publication, immutable plan binding, main integration and cleanup on 2026-11-01. This artifact update preserves objective, bounded scope, criteria, verification seams and native graph. Product satisfaction and completed closure remain separate gates.

Final satisfaction evaluation: SATISFIED for verified delivery 1f072913414da2d9d1a2401b8449b7e3146bfd94 and the unchanged criteria. This supersedes the historical partial assessment disposition without rewriting it.

https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/7c42702331d0eeafe449f826badbd862a1ba5729/tests/scenarios/2026-11-01-issue-5-satisfaction.md

Structured evaluation: https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/7c42702331d0eeafe449f826badbd862a1ba5729/tests/scenarios/2026-11-01-issue-5-satisfaction.json

Final review: https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/7c42702331d0eeafe449f826badbd862a1ba5729/tests/scenarios/2026-11-01-issue-5-satisfaction-review.md

The operator explicitly requested completion of #5. Current lifecycle labels are reconciled through the allowed states using existing approved artifacts and current verification; these are current closeout observations, not newly repeated historical fixture or host acceptance.
